ticket.subject: Cancel our subscription
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

I'm the founder at Wrenfield Partners. Please cancel the Wrenfield Partners subscription when the current term ends; we are consolidating our software.

We will export our projects ourselves before the end date.

Could you confirm the last charge we should expect?

Yours sincerely,
Bruno Albright
founder, Wrenfield Partners
